S. Men's National Soccer Team, founded in 1913, represents the United States on the international stage and has left an indelible mark on the world of soccer. Over the years, the team has witnessed notable moments that have shaped its legacy. One of the defining moments came in 1950 when the underdog U. S. team triumphed over the heavily favored England in the FIFA World Cup, forever etching their name in football history. The team has since participated in multiple World Cups. The U.S. Men's National Team has consistently showcased its talent and determination, becoming a force to be reckoned with in international competitions and fostering the growth of soccer across the nation.Did the U.S. men’s national soccer team qualify for the 2026 FIFA World Cup? Yes, the U.S. men’s national soccer team qualified automatically as one of the three co-hosts of the 2026 World Cup (along with Canada and Mexico).How many times has the U.S. men’s national soccer team played in the World Cup? The 2026 tournament will mark the U.S. men’s national soccer team’s 12th appearance in the FIFA World Cup. Where is the U.S. men’s national soccer team playing its 2026 FIFA World Cup matches? As co-hosts, the U.S. men’s national soccer team will play its matches in U.S. venues. Specifically, the team will host group stage matches at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles (on June 12 and June 25) and Lumen Field in Seattle (on June 19).Has the U.S. men’s national soccer team won the World Cup before? No, the U.S. men’s national soccer team has never won the World Cup. Their best historical finish was third place in 1930.How far did the U.S. men’s national soccer team go in the last World Cup? In the 2022 FIFA World Cup, the U.S. men’s national soccer team reached the Round of 16 before being eliminated by the Netherlands.What group is the U.S. men’s national soccer team in for the 2026 FIFA World Cup? The U.S. men’s national soccer team is in Group D for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The other teams in Group D are Paraguay, Australia, and Turkey.
